resources.basis: 156 fixed-topology fits, maximum 563 proteins and 453 alignment columns; existing host, no GPU or paid resources.

guide_policy: Use profile-domain tree once per input: both guide outputs have identical rooted edge sets and inherited lengths for all 13 domain cases. Retain alias to both guides, not independent replicate fits.
scope: Model and branch-length fitting only. Fixed input topology, retained identical tips, all three model settings kept. No ancestor, rooting inference, model-adequacy or selection conclusion.
